articles.summary: Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI”) (NYSE: XXI) today published its quarterly letter to shareholders from the Company’s Chief Executive Officer, Rapha Zagury. Dear Shareholders, In August, I committed to providing regular, direct updates on our progress. These quarterly letters are an opportunity to explain how we are deploying your capital and building Twenty One. Our mandate is clear: build a durable, cash-generating business around one of the largest corporate Bitcoin treasuries in the world. A balance sheet is not a business. It is our starting point. Over the past quarter, we strengthened our team and governance, and evaluated a number of opportunities across the Bitcoin and energy ecosystem. Much of the work has happened behind the scenes. In this letter, I want to share what has changed, what remains unfinished, and how I am thinking about your capital. Let’s start with the numbers. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, we reported net income of $1.087 billion.
articles.title: Twenty One Capital Issues Shareholder Letter From CEO, Rapha Zagury
